name: immutable
description: Append-only SDD toolkit. v0.6.0 ships nine skills covering the full 7-step flow: /immutable:init bootstraps a starter (spec/app/single × ko/en); /immutable:office-hours forces premise challenge plus 3 alternatives; /immutable:prd authors pitches (WHAT); /immutable:design captures app-side context; /immutable:plan-review-ceo runs scope challenge + 11-section review; /immutable:plan-review-eng runs 4-section engineering review; /immutable:adr authors Architecture Decision Records (WHY); /immutable:ship verifies and creates the PR; /immutable:migrate handles config v2→v3 AND profile field migration (override-preserving). Authoring skills enforce grill-me interview, multi-persona adversarial review, and a 90% completeness gate. The flow runs standalone — no external harness required.
